profile_text.body:
Consensus is a company that operates an AI-powered academic search engine available at consensus.app. The company describes its product as a research operating system designed for finding, organizing, and analyzing peer-reviewed scientific literature, and claims it enables users to work through research tasks ten times faster than conventional methods.

The core product, also called Consensus, falls within the search and research category and is focused on surfacing results from peer-reviewed literature rather than the broader web. No litigation, patent filings, or MCP server registrations are recorded in the held facts for this company.
